name: Robust IQR Burstiness (v2)
description: Measures the structural rhythm and 'burstiness' of a text—the alternating pattern of long, complex sentences with short, punchy ones. Unlike older variance models (v1) that use standard deviation, this v2 algorithm employs Interquartile Range (IQR) analysis. Large Language Models inherently generate text with consistently uniform sentence lengths (low burstiness), optimizing for a safe mathematical average. Human writers naturally employ irregular bursts of sentence lengths for rhetorical pacing. By using IQR, this method ignores extreme outliers that might artificially inflate the 'human' score of an AI text, providing a much harder, highly robust metric for detection.
mechanism: The algorithm segments the text into constituent sentences and calculates the length (in words or characters) of each. It then sorts these lengths and determines the Interquartile Range (the difference between the 75th and 25th percentiles). A low IQR indicates that the vast majority of the text's sentences huddle tightly around a central length—a classic statistical signature of neural network generation. A high IQR indicates genuine, organic structural variation typical of human composition.
useCase: Highly effective as a primary filter for essays, blogs, and articles where AI models naturally converge on medium-length sentences to avoid grammatical collapse.
strengths:
• Highly robust against adversarial prompts; asking an AI to 'write with varied sentence lengths' often results in predictable, repeating patterns rather than true statistical burstiness.
• The IQR mathematical model prevents extreme outliers (e.g., one exceptionally long bulleted list) from creating a false 'human' signature.
limitations:
• Requires texts of at least 250+ words to establish a statistically significant IQR.
• Standardized scientific or legal documents written by humans may naturally exhibit low burstiness due to strict formatting constraints.
parameters:
Analysis: IQR Dispersion Analysis
Metric: Interquartile Range of Token Length per Sentence
Output: 0-100 Burstiness Deficiency (Algorithmic Homogeneity) Score
accuracy: High — 82-88% standalone accuracy on medium-to-long texts. It is one of the most reliable standalone statistical discriminators available.
